label: Fact
headline: Sample: Leaders of a fictional union agree placeholder summit agenda in Sampleburg
dek: A sample EU-politics article about an invented summit of the fictional Union of Northern States. It shows how {{name}} reports an agreed agenda without predicting outcomes.
whatHappened: Leaders of the Union of Northern States, a fictional bloc invented for this sample, agreed a three-item agenda for a placeholder summit in the fictional city of Sampleburg.
The sample agenda lists placeholder items on energy grids, border paperwork and a joint research fund.
whyItMatters: In this sample, an agreed agenda signals which topics leaders are prepared to discuss, but it does not mean any decision has been taken.
confirmed: A three-item agenda was agreed (sample communique).
The summit is scheduled for a placeholder date in December (sample communique).

attributed.claim: The research fund will be the hardest item to agree.
attributed.attributedTo: a fictional diplomat, speaking in a sample background briefing

unknown: Whether any of the three items will produce a formal decision.
How the fictional research fund would be financed.
